The entry's domain (boundary layers, fluid mechanics) confirms contextual relevance to the original problem.

This KB definition is the standard physical meaning used in boundary-layer analysis, so it supports the candidate exponents (L=1, others zero).

The ledger's theta is defined as momentum thickness. The KB record pq_momentum_thickness is the canonical definition for momentum thickness and gives SI dimension L.
